lines.speaker: Saul
lines.text: Take my helmet and armour. Try how they feel before you go.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: They are heavy. My steps do not feel like my own.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I cannot go in these. I have never learned to use them.

lines.speaker: Saul
lines.text: Then take what you know. May the Lord go with you.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Five smooth stones from the brook. My shepherd's sling is enough.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Smooth and round. This one will sit well in the sling.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Five stones, safely in my bag. Now to prepare my sling.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: A steady hand. My trust is in the Lord.
